reconstruction_summary: Imported predict() from module-1/agent-01/final-model/predict.py (V4: per-platform alpha/K_us/tau/beta fit, hard-coded in PARAMS) and called it on every val-data Ford sim.csv.
notes: V0 baselines reproduce to <1e-12 on both KPIs. Agent's final V4 (understeer-gradient + first-order steering lag + bias, per-platform params from REPORT/predict.py) wins both KPIs out-of-sample: yaw RMSE -33.6%, CTE RMSE -23.1%. Yaw-RMSE win cleanly exceeds the CTE win, consistent with a small residual bias accumulating in trajectory but still well below V0 drift.
